messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

For semiconductor companies developing wireless chipsets, modems, RFICs, connectivity SoCs, and reference platforms, the most important **signaling test capabilities** are:

1. **Multi-RAT cellular network emulation**
   - Ability to emulate LTE and 5G NR in both **SA and NSA** modes is foundational for modem/chipset validation.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 covers “LTE and NR in SA/NSA modes.”  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness.md`, section 10.

2. **Protocol validation + RF conformance in one platform**
   - Semiconductor teams need to validate stack behavior, call/session setup, RF performance, and standards conformance before device integration.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 enables “one-stop testing for RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation.”  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing.md`, section 5.

3. **Carrier aggregation and FR1–FR3 / 6G-readiness**
   - Chipset roadmaps increasingly need FR1, FR2, emerging FR3, and cross-band carrier aggregation validation.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 supports FR1 to FR3 up to 18 GHz and carrier aggregation; it is positioned for 5G-Advanced and 6G R&D.  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing.md`, section 5.

4. **High-throughput and advanced PHY validation**
   - Important for premium modems and Wi-Fi/cellular combo chips: high data rates, high-order modulation, antenna-port scaling, and spatial multiplexing.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 is described as supporting data rates up to 20 Gbps, wide dynamic range, 4096QAM, and up to 16 device antenna ports.  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness.md`, section 10.

5. **NTN / satellite / direct-to-cell signaling**
   - NTN is important for modem vendors targeting 3GPP Rel.17+ satellite, IoT, and direct-to-cell use cases.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 covers NR-NTN, NB-NTN, and Direct-to-Cell testing; R&S and MediaTek also demonstrated a 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 test setup.  
   Citations:  
   - `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness.md`, section 10.  
   - `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024.md`, section 7.

6. **Wi-Fi signaling: Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 and future Wi-Fi 8**
   - Semiconductor connectivity SoCs need signaling-mode Wi-Fi validation, especially for Wi-Fi 7 MLO and emerging Wi-Fi 8 features.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 supports WLAN including Wi-Fi 7 and future Wi-Fi 8; another source says Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 signaling can be integrated in every CMX500.  
   Citations:  
   - `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness.md`, section 10.  
   - `raw/Productions/2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card.md`, section 6.

7. **Wi-Fi 7 MLO and multi-RF-chain testing**
   - For Wi-Fi 7 chipsets, Multi-Link Operation requires multiple RF chains and realistic signaling conditions.
   - R&S evidence: Wi-Fi 7 development requires antenna, RF TX/RX measurements “under real-world conditions in signaling mode”; MLO requires multiple RF chains; CMX500 provides integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality and embedded IP test capabilities.  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices.md`, section 6.

8. **OTA signaling and chamber integration**
   - Semiconductor validation increasingly needs OTA behavior, antenna/RF interaction, and real-world wireless performance, not just cabled tests.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 and SMBV100B are integrated with ETS-Lindgren chamber technology and EMQuest software for comprehensive wireless OTA testing.  
   Citation: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and ETS-Lindgren partner to offer OTA testing solutions for next-gen wireless technologies.md`, section 3.

9. **Application-level and IMS services testing**
   - Modem platforms must prove not only RF/protocol behavior but also services such as VoNR, IMS, IP throughput, emergency calling, and user-experience flows.
   - R&S evidence: CMX500 has a built-in IMS server and supports VoNR acoustics; it was also used for NG eCall verification including voice and data transmission.  
   Citations:  
   - `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing.md`, section 5.  
   - `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard.md`, section 5.

**Bottom line:** for semiconductor applications, the critical signaling capabilities are **multi-RAT cellular + Wi-Fi support, protocol/RF conformance, carrier aggregation, FR3/6G readiness, NTN/direct-to-cell, Wi-Fi 7/8 MLO, high-throughput MIMO/4096QAM, OTA chamber integration, and application/IMS service validation**. In the R&S portfolio, the evidence consistently points to the **CMX500** as the central signaling test platform for these needs.

Through this joint effort, Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies have successfully verified the compliance of the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF's NG eCall functionality with the most recent eCall standards. The verification process employed the Rohde & Schwarz [CMX500](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-network-emulator/cmx500-5g-one-box-signaling-tester_63493-601282.html "CMX500") mobile radio tester, a comprehensive testing solution for NG eCall including voice and data transmission. This rigorous test, which was simulating a Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP), validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with the EN 17240:2024 standard. Moreover, the CMX500 supports both 4G and 5G technologies, aiming to provide that the solutions are future-proof.

answer.text:
5G NTN-NR test and verification is important, with Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek demonstrating a 5G NTN-NR test setup for NTN needs [1].  
The R&S CMX500 one-box signaling tester is a key signaling solution for comprehensive wireless technology testing [2].  
OTA and chamber-based testing are important, with CMX500 and R&S SMBV100B integrated with ETS-Lindgren chamber technology and EMQuest software [2].  
NB-IoT NTN and NR NTN test coverage is important, and these capabilities are already covered by the R&S CMW500 and R&S CMX500 [6].  
Automotive modem testing needs NG eCall verification, and the CMX500 provides a comprehensive NG eCall solution including voice and data transmission [5].  
Emergency-call compliance testing can simulate a Public Safety Answering Point and validate EN 17240:2024 compliance at both ends [5].  
Multi-RAT support is important because the CMX500 supports both 4G and 5G technologies [5].

passages.text: At the core of this test solution is the tried and tested CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester from Rohde & Schwarz. This all-in-one test platform supports both SA and NSA architectures, covers frequency ranges from FR1 to FR3 (up to 18 GHz) and features a built-in IMS server, enabling one-stop testing for RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation. With these capabilities, the CMX500 serves as a key test platform for 5G-Advanced and 6G research and development.

passages.text: During the development of WLAN devices, measurements of the antennas as well as RF transmitter and receiver characteristics must be conducted under real-world conditions in signaling mode. With MLO being a key feature in Wi-Fi 7, a test environment that provides multiple RF chains is crucial. The R&S CMX500 one-box tester from Rohde & Schwarz, featuring integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality, is a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester. Its flexibility, support for multiple radio technologies, and embedded IP test capabilities make it a versatile solution for a broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests.

answer.text:
Rohde & Schwarz will demonstrate CMX500 Wi-Fi 8 testing by validating a Broadcom prototype Wi-Fi 8 device at MWC Barcelona 2026 [1].
The CMX500 supports integrated Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E, and Wi-Fi 7 signaling [2].
The CMX500 covers WLAN including Wi-Fi 7 and future Wi-Fi 8 [3].
The CMX500 supports NR-NTN, NB-NTN, and Direct-to-Cell testing [3].
The CMX500 covers FR1 to FR3 up to 18 GHz and supports carrier aggregation testing [4].
The CMX500 supports RF conformance, protocol validation, and VoNR acoustics testing [4].
For Wi-Fi 7, the CMX500 provides integrated test functionality, multiple RF chains for MLO, and embedded IP test capabilities [5].
